summary: Add frozen selector v7 with bounded exact-token page-column context while preserving v3-v6 replay.
decision_refs: Visual inspection and saved word coordinates showed D4 had two clear callout columns whose source blocks were interleaved by vertical position.
V6 supplied row-level layout only when one evidence block contained a large same-line gap, so the each-side sealant phrase remained split across blocks.
Ponytail constraint: reuse existing text_map coordinates and layout_lines instead of adding table extraction, OCR, vision routing, a semantic graph or another dependency.
Historical verification note: synthetic cross-block page-column reconstruction and explicit v6 replay
Historical verification note: targeted QA V3 and complete frozen Reference lifecycle suites
Historical verification note: real fixed-15 expected-page gate and D4 bounded page-column audit
Historical verification note: controlled v6 deployment-mismatch, v7 result and rejected prompt-experiment records with no automatic retry
Historical verification note: full Python, frontend localization, spec, change and bundle gates
approval_evidence: The user explicitly allowed API calls and directed CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue.
known_limitations: The 80-point native column grouping is a deterministic layout aid, not table or leader-line semantics.
V7 improved D4 from partial with an unsupported association to partial with no unsupported claim, but the answer still omitted the leading quantity (3).
A prompt-only quantity preservation experiment ended in a safely settled citation-scope rejection and was rolled back rather than promoted.
The fixed-15 release evaluation has not been rerun under v7.
